title: Oven-Roasted Energizing Kenyan Beef Kidney Quesadilla
description: A crispy and flavorful quesadilla featuring tender beef kidney, inspired by Kenyan cuisine, and fueled by ayurvedic tamasic principles. A true energizing and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the beef kidney and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion, ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the skillet. Cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Slice the cooked beef kidney into thin strips and set aside.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil over medium heat. Place a tortilla in the pan and sprinkle shredded cheese on half of the tortilla.
Add a few slices of the beef kidney on top of the cheese, followed by a sprinkle of chopped cilantro.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted, about 2-3 minutes.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Repeat with the remaining tortillas and filling ingredients.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
